candidate.answerReason: The admissible values of k are exactly the six positive divisors of 12.

methods.label: List the factor pairs
methods.explanation:
Rearranging the equation gives
\[k(x-3)=12.\]
Since \(k>0\), the solution \(x=3+12/k\) is an integer exactly when \(k\) is a positive divisor of \(12\).

The positive factor pairs of \(12\) are
\[(1,12),\qquad (2,6),\qquad (3,4).\]
These are exhaustive: each factor pair must contain a number at most \(3\), because \(4\cdot4>12\). The pairs give the six distinct values \(k=1,2,3,4,6,12\), and each produces an integer \(x\). Therefore the answer is \(\boxed{6}\), choice \(\mathrm{D}\).
